look_here_first: Inspect the yellow head from below: long green outer phyllaries, a domed disk and notched ray tips. Then inspect alternate leaves with clasping upper leaf bases. A mature cypsela has papery pappus scales.

project_inclusion.range_basis: POWO confirms Texas native; three target-zone counties not verified.

morphology_keys.leaves: Alternate; lower spatulate, upper ovate and sessile to clasping.
morphology_keys.heads: Solitary yellow capitula, long outer phyllaries and domed disk.
morphology_keys.fruit: Cypsela with short papery pappus scales.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Compare outer and inner phyllaries, upper leaf attachment, and mature pappus scales rather than flower color.
